lines.text: Which has more pigment cells? Count them, row by row.
lines.phonemes: wˌɪtʃ hɐz mˈɔː pˈɪɡmənt sˈɛlz? kˈaʊnt ðˌɛm, ɹˈəʊ baɪ ɹˈəʊ.

lines.text: Most would guess the darkest. But in the bottom row of skin, each pigment cell feeds melanin to a few dozen neighbours. Across all three, the number comes out about the same.
lines.phonemes: mˈəʊst wʊd ɡˈɛs ðə dˈɑːkɪst. bˌʌt ɪnðə bˈɒtəm ɹˈəʊ ɒv skˈɪn, ˈiːtʃ pˈɪɡmənt sˈɛl fˈiːdz mˈɛlɐnˌɪn tʊ ɐ fjˈuː dˈʌzən nˈeɪbəz. əkɹˌɒs ˈɔːl θɹˈiː, ðə nˈʌmbə kˈʌmz ˈaʊt ɐbˌaʊt ðə sˈeɪm.

lines.text: What changes is the work each one does. In deeper skin, they make more of the dark melanin, in larger grains, handed out one by one.
lines.phonemes: wˌɒt tʃˈeɪndʒɪz ɪz ðə wˈɜːk ˈiːtʃ wˈɒn dˈʌz. ɪn dˈiːpə skˈɪn, ðeɪ mˌeɪk mˈɔːɹ ɒvðə dˈɑːk mˈɛlɐnˌɪn, ɪn lˈɑːdʒə ɡɹˈeɪnz, hˈandɪd ˈaʊt wˈɒn baɪ wˌɒn.

lines.text: So why would the work differ? Nina Jablonski and George Chaplin set skin colour beside sunlight, all around the world, and the two matched.
lines.phonemes: sˌəʊ wˌaɪ wʊd ðə wˈɜːk dˈɪfə? nˈiːnə ʤəblˈɒnski and dʒˈɔːdʒ tʃˈaplɪn sˈɛt skˈɪn kˈʌlə bɪsˌaɪd sˈʌnlaɪt, ˈɔːl ɐɹˈaʊnd ðə wˈɜːld, and ðə tˈuː mˈatʃt.

lines.text: Their idea: under fierce sun, more melanin protected a vitamin called folate. Under weak sun, less of it let enough light through to make vitamin D.
lines.phonemes: ðeəɹ aɪdˈiə: ˌʌndə fˈiəs sˈʌn, mˈɔː mˈɛlɐnˌɪn pɹətˈɛktɪd ɐ vˈɪtəmɪn kˈɔːld fˈəʊleɪt . ˌʌndə wˈiːk sˈʌn, lˈɛs ɒv ɪt lˈɛt ɪnˈʌf lˈaɪt θɹuː tə mˌeɪk vˈɪtəmɪn dˈiː.

lines.text: And on any one part of the body, the pigment cells sit about a third of a paper's thickness apart.
lines.phonemes: and ˌɒn ˌɛni wˈɒn pˈɑːt ɒvðə bˈɒdi, ðə pˈɪɡmənt sˈɛlz sˈɪt ɐbˌaʊt ɐ θˈɜːd əvə pˈeɪpəz θˈɪknəs ɐpˈɑːt.

lines.text: So, which has more? None of them. Same cells, every colour, each answering its own sky.
lines.phonemes: sˈəʊ, wˌɪtʃ hɐz mˈɔː? nˈɒn ɒv ðˌɛm. sˈeɪm sˈɛlz, ˈɛvɹɪ kˈʌlə, ˈiːtʃ ˈansəɹɪŋ ɪts ˈəʊn skˈaɪ.

lines.text: Next: why do we still get goosebumps, with almost no fur?
lines.phonemes: nˈɛkst: wˌaɪ dˈuː wiː stˈɪl ɡɛt ɡˈuːsbʌmps, wɪð ˈɔːlməʊst nˈəʊ fˈɜː?
